notes.title: Hotfix *2
notes.content:
Hello again contestants, another day another round of bug fixing and slight changes.

Changes:
- Now have 5 total lives per Course instead of 4.

Bug Fix:
- When restarting a stage with no more lives left made the game work unintended. This has been fixed.

Thanks for playing!
Andy

notes.title: Hotfix *1 : Fixes a Time Out issue.
notes.content:
Hello contestants, just a quick but important bug fix.

- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if failing a course with a Time Up.

Thank you for playing and reporting any fixes!
Andy,
Robot Legs
